name: Wind Sensor
description: The sensor outputs the wind direction relative to the orientation of the base of the sensor (in number of turns from -0.5 to 0.5) and the wind speed in m/s. Wind data is relative to the speed of the sensor and only measures wind in the plane of the sensor.
shortDescription: A wind sensor for measuring relative wind speed and direction.

logicNodes.label: Wind Direction
logicNodes.description: The direction of the wind relative to the component.
